title: 45°C cooling design cuts data center water use to near zero
summary: NVIDIA has developed a 45°C liquid cooling technology for AI data centers that reduces water consumption to near zero, addressing the massive hydration needs of GPU-intensive AI factories. The innovation enables sustainable high-performance computing while significantly cutting environmental impact.
problem_solved: Dramatically reduces the enormous water consumption required for cooling traditional high-density AI data centers
why_valuable: Enables sustainable AI infrastructure at scale by minimizing water usage while maintaining peak computing performance for generative AI workloads
